verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's own headless `--convert-to` CLI and filter list cover DOCX and EPUB, so it delivers part of this cross-format conversion story. A community user also reports using it in Docker to normalize document formats. missing for 10: no evidence of Markdown, HTML, or LaTeX filters, no evidence of whether EPUB is import or export or both, and no hands-on corroboration of DOCX↔EPUB round-trip fidelity.

support.subject: As a developer, markup and e-book formats (Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB, DOCX) convert between each other
